title: Neural-Bayesian Structure Learning for Discrete Choice Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.25258v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional discrete choice and machine learning models are estimated primarily from observational data and typically treat explanatory covariates as parallel inputs, providing no internal mechanism for determining how related attributes should adjust when one is deliberately changed. This paper proposes Neural-Bayesian Structure Learning (Neural-BSL), a framework coupling differentiable structure learning with random-utility-based discrete choice estimation in a single differentiable procedure. To prevent mutually exclusive choice outcome from distorting the recovered attribute structure, the observed choice is maintained outside the graph as an alternative-specific utility comparison, while the attribute structure and random-utility parameters are learned jointly. The learned structure enters the choice model through structure-weighted attribute interactions and provides the structural basis for propagating interventions through downs

translated_title: 神经贝叶斯结构学习用于离散选择建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25258v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：传统的离散选择和机器学习模型主要从观测数据中估计，通常将解释性协变量视为平行输入，没有内部机制来确定当其中一个属性被有意改变时，相关属性应如何调整。本文提出了神经贝叶斯结构学习（Neural-BSL），一个将可微分结构学习与基于随机效用的离散选择估计耦合在单一可微分过程中的框架。为了防止互斥的选择结果扭曲恢复的属性结构，观测到的选择被保持在图外作为替代特定效用的比较，而属性结构和随机效用参数则被联合学习。学习到的结构通过结构加权的属性交互进入选择模型，并为通过下游传播干预提供结构基础。
tldr: 本文提出Neural-BSL框架，将可微分结构学习与离散选择估计结合，通过保持选择在图外和联合学习属性结构，实现干预传播的结构基础。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Neural-BSL, a framework coupling differentiable structure learning with discrete choice estimation, keeping choices outside the graph and jointly learning attribute structure to enable intervention propagation.
